extensionDescription.message: Focused, offline visual improvements for the Supported Mail Interface.

subtitle.message: Hide the sidebar. Highlight unread mail.

unsupportedDetail.message: Open a supported Yahoo Mail folder to apply these changes.

privacy.message: All preferences are stored on this device.

privacyBoundary.message: No mail data is sent, analyzed, or tracked.

unofficial.message: This independent, unofficial extension is not affiliated with Yahoo.
